name: setup-scripts
description: Idempotently bootstrap zz_use from tomgrv/scripts, optionally installing specific scripts.

SCRIPTS.description: Space-separated tomgrv/scripts tool names to zz_use after bootstrapping (e.g. "git-release-beta git-release-prod"). Leave empty to only bootstrap zz_use itself.

SCRIPTS_REF.description: tomgrv/scripts ref (tag/branch/commit) every name in `scripts` is pinned to, as "<name>@<ref>". Leave empty to use each script's own default origin/ref.

ZZ_SCRIPTS_BRANCH.description: Branch to fetch tomgrv/scripts setup.sh from when bootstrapping zz_use (default "main", typically overridden to a development branch during integration testing).
